payload.title: security-boundary-adapter.nats.test.ts asserts the exact findings of the real gateway bridge files and patches the real factory text, but aria-adapters:test does not list those files as inputs, so the change that falsifies the pin does not run the test
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.nats.test.ts:188-204 (clean-main baseline: the real apps/gateway-api websocket bridges must be exactly the two READ findings)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.nats.test.ts:50-57 (the test reads and patches the real libs/backend-common nats factory file)
tools/aria-adapters/project.json:20-37 (inputs of the test target: default, tools/gates, infrastructure, compose files and a few manifests; no apps/** and no libs/backend-common)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/nats-bridge.service.ts:112-114 (the file whose state the pin depends on)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md Test Rules (nx affected --target=test must fire on the change a test guards); a test whose subject is outside its declared inputs can stay green in the PR that falsifies it.
payload.notes: The planned follow-up moves both gateway bridges onto buildNatsConnectionOptions, which empties the READ finding list this test pins. That PR touches apps/gateway-api, whose nx project is affected, but aria-adapters is not (its inputs name no apps or libs/backend-common file), so the PR is green and the test goes red on the next run that does include aria-adapters, in an unrelated PR or on main. The failure is loud but late and is attributed to the wrong change. Close condition: Either add the two bridge files and libs/backend-common/src/nats/** to the inputs of the aria-adapters test target, or move the clean-main baseline out of the test; checkable by `nx show projects --affected --files=apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/nats-bridge.service.ts` listing aria-adapters. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 1). Verified at head a47dc4d57c of open pull request #2134; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
